pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Verse 1]
Moonlight slips through the cracks of the window
Your scent still lingers in my room
I’m too weak to even open the door
Like your tears, it weighs down my heart

[Chorus]
Your love was moonlight fallen into a well
Quietly brushing shadows away while I slept
I send what’s left of your breath on the wind
Until even the moonlight fades into the dark

[Verse 2]
Your name I once held tight in my hands
Now I’m slowly letting it go
Like sand slipping through my fingers
Softly, so it won’t hurt

[Pre-Chorus]
When you bloom again someday
I hope my scent is nowhere near
Even in the corners of your memory
I’ll disappear like spring rain

[Bridge]
Your season grew too heavy
So I became winter and walked away
Falling quietly like autumn leaves
Waiting once more for spring

[Chorus]
I erased your name with my tears
May there be not a single cloud in your sky
If this goodbye is my final gift to you
It’s proof of how deeply I loved you

[Final Chorus]
I told myself it’s better if I’m the one in pain
Days I lied just to endure
If it means you hurt a little less
Then that was my love

[Outro]
This goodbye was for you
For your own spring ahead
“Now, bloom quietly”
pkg.sunoStyle:
Trendy pop with a soft, energetic groove. Modern, fresh and emotional.
Male-female duet vocals throughout. Alternating lines, natural vocal interplay, gentle harmonies, clear and expressive vocals. Keep both voices distinct and balanced.
Light and simple intro with soft harmony. Verses begin gently with light rhythm, subtle percussion and restrained bass. Pre-chorus gradually builds emotional tension through delicate textures and rhythmic movement, without sudden intensity.
Chorus adds warmth and energy with warm bass, gentle harmonies and a smooth rhythmic lift. Emotional and engaging, but controlled and never explosive.
Final section gradually reduces energy, returning to soft duet vocals and minimal accompaniment, ending calm and reflective.
Natural dynamics, warm tone, clean modern production. Avoid loud mastering, heavy bass, excessive drums, dense layers and aggressive instrumentation.
